title: Joule Sous Vide Session Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=joule:cook
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(protein_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Joule sous vide session events land each day and how many distinct protein values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Joule sous vide session records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct protein values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It compares your how much Joule sous vide session activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
